title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E02 — That Car's Flying!
Hurricane Idalia sweeps away coastal homes and flips a car 350 miles away.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E08 — Jamaica Category 5
Tourists and locals endure catastrophic winds and flooding as Category 5 Hurricane Melissa tears across Jamaica; as guests scramble to take shelter, resorts in Montego Bay suffer structural failure, while torrential rain inundates Black River.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E12 — The 40-State Storm
In January 2026, a 2000-mile winter storm unleashes chaos across 40 states; a 100-car pileup traps motorists in Michigan, a freight train smashes a stranded semi and first responders race to save a driver sinking in a frozen pond.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E13 — Three Rivers, Four Tornadoes
A lone supercell thunderstorm in March 2026 spawns unexpected late winter tornadoes in the upper Midwest, including the earliest-ever EF-3 tornado to hit Michigan.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E03 — Helene's Appalachian Hellscape
Hurricane Helene barrels north into Appalachia, dumping 30 inches of rain; as hundreds of cameras capture flooding and mudslides, one woman gets swept away by the deluge, until a man attending a wedding rehearsal jumps into the water to save her.

description:
S01 E04 — Hummer, but Make It Bigger
A repeat client wants a tall, big work truck, so the team decides to build the world's first-ever, lifted Hummer EV; Ashley sets a company sales goal of 25 trucks at the upcoming Palm Beach Boat Show, sparking family tension.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E09 — A Wrinkle in Time
Johnathan alters time in an attempt to get to port for an anniversary he promised Heather on land; Rick battles a Bering Sea gale that knocks his deckhand out of commission; Sophia helms the Seabrooke in the roughest weather she's ever seen.

title: Airplane Repo
description:
S01 E02 — Spies in the Night
Mike braves a potential suicide mission in California; Kevin is at the mercy of a mechanic and a windy night.

title: Airplane Repo
description:
S01 E04 — Narrow Escape
Mike braves gators in Florida to retrieve a Cessna Float plane; Ken and Danny have an encounter with an angry debtor.

title: Airplane Repo
description:
S01 E10 — Repo Roulette
Mike Kennedy sky-dives into an airfield in a bid to snatch a de Havilland Twin Otter; Ken Cage and Danny Thompson attempt a risky two-vehicle snatch.

title: Airplane Repo
description:
S01 E09 — Flying Blind
Ken Cage tries to repossess two high-end yachts in just two days; Kevin Lacey attempts a white-knuckle landing on a runway with no lights.

Aerospace fasteners; cactus pear purée; lab reactors.

Curious minds find out how things like graphene, the world's smallest car, force testers and composite cars are manufactured.

S31 E03 — Spinning Reels; Plasma Protein Therapies; 3D Cups
Exploring the production processes of everyday items, including spinning reels, plasma protein therapies, 3D cups and stainless steel beer kegs.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E06 — A Smuggler's Guide to Weight Loss
After a K9 alerts to a vehicle, officers have trouble finding anything, but eventually a secret compartment reveals its contents.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E02 — Grab Bag
Officers find a man and his family driving a suspiciously modified truck; a young man is caught with narcotics strapped to his body; a crosser is detained for having a record of smuggling an illegal migrant across the border.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E07 — A Drop in the Bouquet
Cartels hope CBP won't inspect happy families, but officers know not to fall for that smuggling trick. Due to avian flu, live chickens can't be brought into the U.S.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E08 — Just Doing My Duty
Each year, CBP recovers over 1,300 stolen vehicles at ports of entry. Many are heading to the black market, while cartels use others for trafficking. When officers receive a be on the lookout (BOLO) alert for a luxury car, they take it seriously.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E09 — Boomers Behaving Badly
Tourist Day celebrates the thousands of Americans who migrate south during the winter months. With 11,000 visitors expected, officers are preparing themselves for festivities fueled by alcohol and drugs.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
For Better ... or Worse
Millions of travelers cross the U.S. borders every year. And while some are innocent couples, others are partners in crime. Because at the border, love isn't always what it seems.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E12 — Loudoun County Adult Detention Center
In one of America's wealthiest counties, Loudoun County Adult Detention Center serves the wealthy and the impoverished alike by running rehab programs, chasing contraband, and giving every inmate — rich or poor — a shot at a brighter future.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E11 — Tennessee Dyer County Jail
At Tennessee's Dyer County Jail, overcrowding, contraband and violence strain an understaffed facility, where drugs have been smuggled in by officers and violence among inmates has turned deadly.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E03 — Suffolk County Correctional Facility
As an opioid epidemic grips the county, a law-and-order sheriff uses rehabilitation to help inmates break the cycle of addiction while officers work around the clock to maintain safety, security and order inside one of New York's busiest jails.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E01 — Rivers of Easy Gold
Dave Turin shows where everyday miners can find the new gold uncovered in California, talking about a number of ways ranging from picking nuggets out of rivers to metal detecting rare gold worth millions.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E10 — Under the Gun
With the clock ticking on the fall season, Sig devises a way to simultaneously silence his crew and fish faster; as Wild Bill goes under the knife, he elevates Landon to captain the Summer Bay; after giving Jack fishing intel, Keith smells a rat.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E06 — Vegas Hall Pass
Pineapple argues with a woman who has a hall pass from her husband; Jeremy gets in a fight, and Elmer hunts for a massive haul; TW's easy tow turns into an ordeal, while a crazy customer goes ballistic on Bridgett; Shawn makes a spooky discovery.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E03 — Shawn Comes Up Snake Eyes
At a call on the Strip, Shawn is shocked by a six-foot python in a car's front seat; TW tangles with a motel customer twice his size; Elmer races to rescue a fellow driver in danger; a driver's window is smashed.

title: Sin City Tow
description:
S01 E10 — New Year's Eve Hustle & Tow
The tow truck drivers hustle on the craziest night of the year in Las Vegas: New Year's Eve; Jeremy tries to break a record; Elmer makes a life-changing decision; Pineapple faces the wrath of his boss.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E03 — Seaside Speakeasy Conspiracy
Mark, Digger and Tim investigate a Prohibition-era speakeasy in Connecticut that served bootleg liquor to the hottest celebrities of the day; when New York's mobsters come calling, glamour gives way to gunplay, federal agents close in.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E04 — Texas Bootleg Betrayal
Mark, Digger and Tim investigate a small TX town that became a moonshine capital during Prohibition.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E05 — Moonshine, Marijuana and Murder
Mark, Digger and Tim uncover a backcountry murder mystery tied to Kentucky moonshiners who swapped cannabis for corn liquor.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E06 — Bones in the Backwoods
When a moonshine kingpin murdered a rogue bootlegger in 1948, fear kept witnesses silent.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E03 — Wylde Mountain Reckoning
In Montana, the Raneys intervene with a family on winter's doorstep; they must scramble to expand their shelter and food storage before being snowed in for good; a surprising revelation in the middle of the rescue threatens to upend the Raneys' plan.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E02 — A Homestead Divided
On a mesa in Arizona, the Raneys step into a homestead and marriage under strain; to secure the family's future, they must pull an ambitious husband away from his years-long, unfinished passion project, and force a hard reset before total collapse.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E06 — North Carolina DIY or Die
After the tragic loss of his father and wife, a young homesteader attempts to survive alone in the mountains of NC using off-grid skills he learned online; when the Raneys intervene, they find a crumbling shelter and no means of subsistence.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E02 — Stranger Danger
Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E02 — Big Bang Theories
Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E13 — From Rats to Riches
Matt's team goes full hazmat suit to tackle a rat-infested hoard that is rumored to have cash hidden in every room, if the rats haven't eaten it already; the team also hunts for vintage Playboys, a rare samurai sword and original G.I. Joe toys.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E03 — Dirt Bike Pay Dirt
Taking a big risk, Matt tackles two out-of-control California hoards; it's a race against the clock as Matt hunts for classic motorcycles in a toxic hoard and then chases rare, high-priced toys in a property across the state.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S01 E09 — The Loch Ness Conspiracy
Using state-of-the-art science, Jeremy Wade chases new leads in pursuit of the Loch Ness monster's hiding place.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E11 — Blow the Man Down
Mother Nature blows back as the four remaining captains battle to tank their fall quotas; Landon prays for deliverance on his first solo mission; Sig persists in fishing in 20-foot seas.

title: Gold Rush
description:
Sneak Peeks! Rocky Mountain Wreckers and Gold Rush
The ultimate gold showdown continues with new episodes of Gold Rush Fridays at 8 followed by new series Rocky Mountain Wreckers at 9 on Discovery.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S09 E03 — Desolation of Ponte City
A looming skyscraper that was once an exclusive residential complex turns into a dystopian ruin in Johannesburg, South Africa; experts investigate and uncover a symbolic structure of urban decay under the shameful shadow of apartheid.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S09 E07 — Ruins of the Zoo Fortress
The ruins of a coastal fortress sit atop a jagged outcrop along the beaches of Wales; experts investigate and uncover a derelict 19th-century British fortification that housed a series of occupants, including an exotic, private zoo.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S09 E14 — Hidden Tunnels of Gibraltar
A forgotten military fortification connected to a network of secret tunnels are mysteriously hidden within the Rock of Gibraltar; experts investigate and uncover a derelict war-torn complex constructed for a highly classified WWII spy operation.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S09 E08 — Hidden Hell of Angel Island
A cluster of military defensive structures among a quaint holiday village lie deserted on a San Francisco Bay island; experts investigate and uncover a mysterious Civil War outpost that conceals a dark and hellish history.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E04 — Riches of Spain's Pirate King
Hot on the trail of a stolen fortune, Josh chases the treasure of the infamous Spanish pirate Amaro Pargo; an exhaustive hunt of Pargo's stomping grounds in the Canary Islands leads Josh beneath an active volcano to dive for the pirate's hoard.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E03 — Lost City of the Gospels
Josh travels to the Holy Land to find a lost city where Jesus performed many miracles and is home to three apostles; while investigating competing sites that claim to be the lost city, Josh reveals an inscription that hasn't been seen in 1,400 years.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E03 — Lost City of the White Jaguar
Trekking deep into Mexico's narco-controlled jungles, Josh hunts for the last Mayan stronghold to ward off the Spanish conquistadors; he joins an expedition braving snakes, spiders and jaguars to uncover the legendary Sac Balam.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S16 E01 — Mysteries of the Great Pyramid
With exclusive access to one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, Josh unravels wild conspiracy theories about the pyramid; crawling through every passage under the pyramid, Josh searches for the lost tomb and treasure of the Pharaoh Khufu.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S16 E02 — Great Pyramid Secrets Revealed
To solve the mystery of the pyramid's construction, Josh joins a daring experiment to replicate its ancient build; first-of-their-kind 3D scans of a mysterious tunnel system could uncover a labyrinth of secrets buried deep beneath the stone.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E07 — Mystery Ruins of the Stone Age
Josh investigates the rumors swirling around a Turkish dig site that is 6,000 years older than Stonehenge; separating fact from fiction, the team uncovers evidence of tribal skull rituals, debunking the legend of an alien-constructed observatory.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E08 — Buried Souls of Pendleton Part 1
Zak and the crew arrive in historic Pendleton, Oregon, to investigate dark hauntings in its storied subterranean tunnels.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E09 — Buried Souls of Pendleton Part 2
Zak and the crew continue their terrifying investigation of historic Pendleton, Oregon; a tip from a local sends the team to an unexplored section of the town's mysterious tunnel system that may bring more shameful secrets, and a curse, to light.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E06 — Rage on the River
In Reno, NV, Zak helps a couple consumed by overwhelming darkness while renovating the abandoned River Inn, causing them to sleep in an RV; the crew suspects nearby hot springs are connected to the unnerving activity and the property's history.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E07 — Gold Town Terror
Known as the gateway to the Gold Rush, claim jumpers, bandits, gamblers and bootleggers stained the town with blood and darkness, attracting demons from hell that never left.

title: Ghost Adventures: Devil Island
description: Chaos follows the crew as they cross the San Francisco Bay to investigate the deceptively named Angel Island; the guys face residual anger emanating from a demonic darkness.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S31 E02 — Possession in Pilot Rock
The crew is unexpectedly called to confront demonic forces in rural Oregon.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E12 — Condemned in Calico
Zak and the crew roll into a Wild West town to confront a posse of volatile spirits that are tormenting the living; the many deaths from this desert outpost's lawless past have infused the very rocks with a dark energy that cannot be contained.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E12 — Raw Winter
Sig and Keith risk fishing far from land despite a forecast, Super El Niño season and encounter a gauntlet of Bering Sea weather; after sand fleas consume his bait, Johnathan strategically sets pots near a submarine volcano.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E06 — Invisible Weapon of War
Andrew tests a disturbing theory: is a secret, directed-energy weapon used in Venezuela the smoking gun behind unexplained attacks on U.S. government officials overseas?

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E08 — Secrets of the Drug War
Going deeper while investigating the modern war on drugs, testing theories around the question: if the war is real, why are drug cartels more wealthy and powerful than ever?
